why_not: My workshop gives me a price on WhatsApp in a minute and my cousin had his bumper done there, so I already know who to trust. A new app with partners only just being added in Riyadh and Cairo is a stranger I would have to pay money into.

The price range is fine, but I would be paying an installer I have never met for work I cannot see until it is done. I already have a workshop I trust and I negotiate with them face to face, so I would have to be convinced the partners are better than the people I know.

My workshop already gives me a price on WhatsApp in a minute, and they have done my cars for years. I would have to learn a new app and wait for strangers to quote me when I already know who I trust.

I also don't need paint protection film this month, so I would wait until I can see a real partner near me with times I can pick.
